remarks: Looking for a diamond in the rough. 39 Bayview Ave Located in a CD2 Zone. Classic 1900 Tudor with original details, ready for a new owner to rejuvenate and restore its timeless charm. Entryway leading to a good sized Living room with wood burning fireplace, off the living room a reading nook; and sunroom/office. Spacious eat in kitchen, dining room (currently being used as a bedroom #6) wall in archway can easily be opened back up. Second floor - 3 good sized bedrooms and Full hall bath. 3rd Story is finished with bedroom #4 and a full bath. Thru the 3rd bedroom you will find the staircase leading to the 3rd floor and hall to the attached studio with Full updated bath. Studio/Possible in-law can also be accessed from an exterior staircase in rear of house. Basement was finished but had water and now is very moldy. Ice damming occurred and there is a leak at the base of the staircase. Field card states 6 bedrooms- this includes the DR as one of the bedrooms. Buyers and Agents to do their own research/diligence as this is a Strictly AS-IS Sale. Inspections will be for informational purposes only. Additional photos and Floor plans will be coming .
